Marco Tiberio
ResearchInfo

Marco Tiberio is a documentary and typological photographer and visual artist based in Amsterdam. His main interest is to understand how human beings react to the changes in society and how they interact with it and the world they live in. Through photography he wants to find new ways of investigating topics in order to make them more accessible to a broader public and give them new interpretations.

In 2020 he has been a recipient of the Stimuleringsfonds to develop a photographic project about how society deals with memories of migrations and colonies during and after WW2.

Marco has been a guest teacher at the Academy of Architecture of Amsterdam.
